propositions: Workflow editor must expose effective review policy derived from built-in criteria plus project overlays as a separate read-only view from the editable Authored Workflow topology
Project code-review LLM criteria require non-empty list of non-empty repository-relative applies_to globs; save validation rejects empty/missing selectors with remedy suggestion
Effective Policy view displays criterion provenance (digest, source, gate, tier, posture, applicability, enabled/disabled state) from CriteriaSnapshot without serializing edits back to workflow
Policy validation failures mark Effective Policy unavailable with actionable error message and prevent save; packaged defaults are never substituted as fallback
Authored workflow document must round-trip byte-equivalently while Effective Policy view changes with project policy updates
